title: म्हेन्दु
description: Devkota's गीतिकाव्य (lyric poem) म्हेन्दु — the poetic fruit of his 2003 BS journey toward Gosaikunda — sings of म्हेन्दु, a Tamang highland flower-maiden, and of love amid the Helambu mountains, in five short sections (प्रथम–पञ्चम) of brief Tamang/Bhote-rhythm stanzas. It opens with Devkota's own note 'म्हेन्दुको विषयमा', where he likens the attempt to मुनामदन's म्याउरे-छन्द experiment. First published by साझा प्रकाशन (2015 BS); digitized from the print edition by OLE Nepal / pustakalaya.org.

rights.basis: Author died 1959; Nepal's Copyright Act 2059 grants life + 50 years, expiring 2009. Verify before publishing.
